controls.role: unconditional redundant per-parse copy work; correct but slower
exact pinned upstream source; scores ~normalization by construction
independently authored per-instance encoded-fragment serialization cache with full mutation invalidation; every distinct instance still pays a real first serialization
train-vocabulary fingerprint fast path plus a failed-recognition tax on the validation vocabulary; wins train and loses validation

perturbation.description: cache percent-encoded URLSearchParams name=value fragments per instance, invalidate on every list mutation, so the 64 repeated toString() per fresh instance skip re-encoding while every distinct instance still performs a real first serialization
